config.notes: Two page kinds. (1) Murdoch course pages www.murdoch.edu.au/course/<level>/<code> (most pages, read by direct fetch): the 'Course fees' block prints 'First year fee <year> $domestic <next year> $domestic First year fee <year> $international <next year> $international', then 'Full course fee' the same way; the fee pattern takes the international first-year fee for the first year shown (the page says it is a typical full-time first-year load of 24 credit points, so annual); checked against CRICOS registered totals (annual x years). For courses of one year or less the first-year fee can be the whole-course amount. 'Start dates' table lists sessions only (Semester 1/2, year, campus, attendance), no months, so intakes are not read here; campus is read from that table; AQF level and breadcrumb study level are read too. Study mode and duration are not reliable in directly fetched pages (filled in by the browser), so no pattern. Research pages have no fee (Fee Calculator only). (2) CourseLoop handbook pages handbook.murdoch.edu.au/courses/<yy>/<code>: page data __NEXT_DATA__ props.pageProps.pageContent (cricos_code, title, offering = sessions, duration_ft_std, ielts_overall_score, english_language_requirements) and text 'Equivalent of an Academic IELTS overall score of X'; no fees. 5 Oct 15:22 (exit awards and requirements): entry_requirement reads the postgraduate 'Admission requirements' sentence on course pages (e.g. Recognised Bachelor's degree ...) and the handbook 'Entry requirements (onshore)' line; undergraduate course pages show only ATAR and a country selector (international academic requirements chosen by country in the browser), so no undergraduate requirement is read. No exit_awards: pages print only 'Alternative exits' for combined degrees (each a separate course with its own page). No fee_total: course pages print the international first-year fee (24 credit points, annual). Saved without apply: an apply would re-queue 12 needs_render pages for Firecrawl.
